name: Legacy 3: The Hidden Relic
summary:
In this game, you’ll explore a newly discovered temple that has been forgotten for thousands of years. It contains many rooms packed with puzzles and riddles, waiting for you to uncover its secrets.
Your old friend has been living in the temple for the past few months, investigating and trying to solve its mysteries. Then suddenly, no one hears from him anymore. The only person brave enough to enter the temple and search for him is, of course, you.
Will you find him? The temple is working against you, with each room filled to the brim with puzzles and riddles trying to stop you from uncovering all its secrets.

Some puzzles are like mini-games that you can solve right away; others require you to pause and observe your surroundings for clues. Some are easy, while others are much more difficult. The game features a built-in hint system that will nudge you in the right direction or completely reveal the solution if you choose. There’s no need to get stuck, as the next room awaits with new puzzles to solve and items to discover!

This game is in 3D, with smooth controls and a camera that allows you to take photos of anything in the game. No need to memorize difficult hints or notes!

So what are you waiting for? The adventure awaits! Can you solve all the puzzles and find your friend?
